insights: The palette is strictly monochromatic, relying exclusively on black, white, and grays to allow vibrant movie posters and trailers to serve as the only distinct sources of color.
A significant portion of the page uses inverted dark sections (hero, footer, banners), evoking a cinematic, theater-in-the-dark mood consistent with a film production company.
Grayscale shades are employed functionally for typographic hierarchy, with mathematically distinct grays assigned to eyebrows, disclaimers, and UI element backgrounds.
